The reinforcement will be an overlay of reinforced vinyl ester resin.  Resin will be Derkane® 411 or equal.  Derkane® 510C with 5% antimony trioxide or equal to achieve an ASTM E84 Class 1 flame spread rating will be used in the last two layers of mat.  The reinforcement will be commercial grade, E type, glass fiber with Silane finish compatible with the resin system.  The outside exposed surface of all reinforcement will be pigmented (colour to be confirmed) and contain UV inhibitors.

Reinforcement will be applied to lengths of piping to a thickness given above (see 'Overlay Thk').  The reinforcement will be applied by filament winding or hand lay-up to achieve a cured laminate of minimum 62 MPa ultimate tensile strength.
Joints in polypropylene pipe to be butt fusion or flanged.  Hand welding is not permitted.  Field joints in accordance with an approved procedure are permitted.
